answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and books one heat-treatment run at an oasis forge. The forge publishes the run's temperature curve on the nebula chart, key-bound, and an auditor recomputes the curve against the certificate: a claimed peak absent from the chart burns the bond. The fee starts at 26 and rises by 6 per run, so the 1000th fake pays 6020; 1000 fakes lock 70000 and pay 3023000 in fees. A rented-certificate ring fails because a reused curve already sits on the oasis forge's nebula chart under another key. An honest identity pays 26 once and recovers its bond after audit.
